title: toxocarpus maritimus
intro: Toxocarpus maritimus, commonly known as the "seaside toxocarpus," is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including providing relief from fever, headaches, and skin conditions. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Toxocarpus maritimus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which may be responsible for its health benefits and medicinal applications.
